name: legacyfetch-migration
goal: Move every legacyFetch caller under src/ to httpClient, preserving behavior, with nothing broken.

lanes.prompt: In every file under {item} that calls legacyFetch(...), replace the call with the equivalent httpClient.get/post call (rule observed in this codebase: `import { legacyFetch } from '../lib/legacyFetch.js'; ... const r = await legacyFetch(url); return r.json();` becomes `import { httpClient } from '../lib/httpClient.js'; ... return httpClient.get(url);` — httpClient.get already returns the parsed object, no .json() call). Keep behavior identical, remove the now-unused legacyFetch import, then run `node --check` on each touched file and `npm test` from {root}, and return the observed result lines as evidence. Touch nothing outside {item}. Any caller whose call shape does not match this rule (e.g. non-GET usage, extra options): leave it unmodified and return DONE_WITH_CONCERNS naming the file and why.

synth.prompt: List every item whose status is not DONE first, with the concern; then the DONE scopes with their test evidence line. Note the total count of legacyFetch call sites migrated vs. left untouched.
